blocks.content:
The [Spec](intent://local/note/spec) is written with the decided design and three tasks. Summary:

## New comment model

- **One comment shape**: "This fix is included in `<component>` vX.Y.Z." — no channel wording, and beta/stable promotion comments are removed entirely (notifier steps deleted from all four promotion workflows).
- **Completeness gate ("stay silent until complete")**: before posting, the notifier enumerates the issue's linked fix PRs across both component repos. intentd posts only when all intentd-side PRs are merged and contained in the released tag; cloudlands-fe posts only when all fe PRs are in the fe tag **and** all intentd PRs are contained in the bundled intentd version. Anything open, unbundled, or indeterminate (API/token failure) → skip with a warning, never a false claim.
- **fe scans the bundled intentd delta**: in addition to its own range, the fe notifier scans intentd commits `v{prev pin}..v{new pin}` (both values already computed in the publish job) — this is what produces the previously-missing "cloudlands-fe v2.45.1 has the fix" comment.

Replaying your screenshot's scenario under the new model: silence at v2.45.0 → "This fix is included in intentd v0.6.21." → "This fix is included in cloudlands-fe v2.45.1 (bundles intentd v0.6.21)."

## Tasks

1. **Rework intentd notifier** — script + `publish-channel-manifest.yml`, drop notifier from both promote workflows.
2. **Rework cloudlands-fe notifier** — script (delta scan + cross-repo gate) + `release-beta.yml` (pass previous pin), drop notifier from promotion workflows.
3. **Update monorepo docs** — AGENTS.md release-notifier section (after 1–2 settle the wording).

Tasks 1 and 2 run in parallel (independent repos); task 3 follows.

**One risk called out in the spec**: the completeness gate needs a token that can read PRs in the private `intent-hq/intentd` repo — a token without that access would silently see no intentd PRs and defeat the gate. Implementors will verify the existing secrets suffice and report back if a permission needs to be added rather than shipping a weakened gate.

Please review and approve the plan above.
